rule.statement: Promote an arm-E candidate only if, on the controller-only development panel, (1) over the windows its applicability predicate admits, it decides at least 1/10 of the records and at least 19/20 of its decisions are correct, with no execution error and no non-label result; (2) the new library version (approved entries in library order, first decision per record) has panel precision and coverage no lower than the current version; (3) artifact/promotion-evidence :verified-cases: no record the current version labels correctly is lost, and at least one more record is labelled correctly; (4) no reserved or conflicting name and at most 16 preloaded functions. Exact integer arithmetic. Otherwise the candidate is kept as rejected with its reasons and the pin is unchanged.
